g.text: Scenario 30: Movie Theatre Ticket Booking and Box Office Analysis System • Course: 25ITT31 (DBMS)
E-R DIAGRAM NOTATION GUIDE & CARDINALITY MATRIX
Strong Entity Set (Physical Table in Database)
• MOVIE ↔ SHOW_SCHEDULE (1:N): One movie has multiple scheduled shows; each show exhibits 1 movie.
• SCREEN ↔ SHOW_SCHEDULE (1:N): One screen hosts multiple shows; each show is assigned to 1 screen.
• SHOW_SCHEDULE ↔ BOOKING (1:N): One show accommodates multiple customer bookings.
• CUSTOMER ↔ BOOKING (1:N): One customer can reserve tickets across multiple shows.
• BOOKING ↔ CANCELLATION (1:0..1): A confirmed booking can optionally be cancelled at most once.
• BOOKING ↔ PAYMENT (1:1): Each ticket reservation must have exactly one payment settlement record.
